answer: Anchor each identity to a distinct physical place: a GPS fix signed by several independent satellite witnesses proves the agent stands somewhere real, not in a server farm. A grove of a thousand fakes would need a thousand separate locations, each with its own signed fix, while one honest agent passes with a single tide of coordinates. At its nadir, a farm collapses into one rooftop and the shared fix exposes it. Limit: GPS can be spoofed, rural agents have weak coverage, and location leaks privacy, so it should gate high-weight actions only.
